QUOTE: "Dynamic checks are opt-in and off by default: `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_MEMSAN` (clang MSan) and `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_VALGRIND` (memcheck)."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names the off-by-default MSan/valgrind testing facility. It never says the facility is explicitly not part of the library API, and the item needs both.
